svg.aria-label: How a cloud works, as four stacked layers from the bottom up. 1, the resource pool: servers, storage, and networks shared by many customers through multi-tenancy, with each tenant isolated. 2, the service models the provider rents out from the pool: IaaS for virtual machines, PaaS for a platform for your code, and SaaS for a finished application; a bar on each shows that you manage less and the provider manages more from IaaS to SaaS. 3, the foundational services that make renting possible: self-service, network access, elastic scaling, and metering and billing. 4, the management services every customer needs: security, monitoring, data management, and integration.
svg.title: How a cloud works: resource pool, service models, foundational services, and management services
svg.text: Four layers, from the bottom up
